tech_stack: Python 3.11+, click, cryptography (Fernet), sqlite3, difflib, pydantic

codebase_patterns.architecture: Three-layer: cli.py (user interaction) -> store.py/diff.py (business logic) -> core.py (utilities)

file_structure.core.py: DB initialization, connection helpers, encryption utilities

codebase_patterns.error_handling: Catch specific exceptions first (FileNotFoundError, IntegrityError), then generic Exception. Use click.echo(err=True) + sys.exit(1)
codebase_patterns.db_pattern: Open connection, try/except/finally, always close in finally block. Row factory set to sqlite3.Row
codebase_patterns.encryption: Fernet (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256) via cryptography library. PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 100k iterations for key derivation

env_vars.PROMPTPASS: Passphrase for encryption key derivation (fallback key if empty)

common_mistakes: Always use parameterized SQL queries (? placeholders), never string formatting
Always close DB connections in finally blocks
Validate user input before processing (empty content, missing versions)
datetime.utcnow() is deprecated in Python 3.12+ - consider datetime.now(timezone.utc)
security_patterns: Content always encrypted before storage, decrypted on retrieval
Key derived from passphrase, never stored plaintext
UNIQUE constraints on (name, version) for data integrity
